endorsements.name: Daniel Basta
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-11623
endorsements.description:
Authentik project is vulnerable to Stored XSS attacks through uploading crafted SVG files that are used as application icons. 
This action could only be performed by an authenticated admin user.
The issue was fixed in 2024.10.4 release.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 4.8)

endorsements.name: Daniel Basta
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-15540
endorsements.description:
"Functions" module in Raytha CMS allows privileged users to write custom code to add functionality to application. Due to a lack of sandboxing or access restrictions, JavaScript code executed through Raytha’s “functions” feature can instantiate .NET components and perform arbitrary operations within the application’s hosting environment.

This issue was fixed in version 1.4.6.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.6)

endorsements.description:

endorsements.label: CVE-2025-69238
endorsements.description:
Raytha CMS is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery across multiple endpoints. Attacker can craft special website, which when visited by the authenticated victim, will automatically send POST request to the endpoint (e. x. deletion of the data) without enforcing token verification. 

This issue was fixed in version 1.4.6.

endorsements.name: Daniel Basta
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-69240
endorsements.description:
Raytha CMS allows an attacker to spoof `X-Forwarded-Host` or `Host` headers to attacker controlled domain. The attacker (who knows the victim's email address) can force the server to send an email with password reset link pointing to the domain from spoofed header. When victim clicks the link, browser sends request to the attacker’s domain with the token in the path allowing the attacker to capture the token. This allows the attacker to reset victim's password and take over the victim's account.

This issue was fixed in version 1.4.6.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 7.5)

endorsements.label: CVE-2025-69246
endorsements.description:

This issue was fixed in version 1.4.6.
